name: One Step at a Time
source:
A gentle, story-driven game that follows Momo, a neurodivergent patient, through the experience of visiting a new dentist for a routine appointment. Starting from home, then to the waiting room, and finally into the dentist's room, Momo is supported by characters like Dr. Berry the bunny dentist, Fern the ferret receptionist and Poppy the octopus dental assistant, throughout his appointment. 

[From [url=https://atomicpsythe.itch.io/one-step-at-a-time]itch.io[/url]]
